messages.openai_key: OpenAI API key not set. The illustrated visual style needs it — Gemini has no transparency option, so there is no fallback. Add an OpenAI key on the dashboard Settings page, or choose another visual style.

picture.opening: Scene 1 shows the subject of the first sentence from frame 0, already moving: the generated character mid-pose or the image already pushing in. Never a title card, a blank frame or an abstract gradient.
picture.turn: A new scene starts on the first word of a turn or a re-opening, and its picture is visibly different from the scene before (a new image, the diagram's next state, a new place). Never merge that segment into the scene before it.
picture.payoff: The payoff scene gets the video's strongest picture: the hero image, the largest element, the diagram fully built.
picture.ending: Hold on the payoff picture to the last frame. No closing card, logo, recap or sign-off after it.

best_for: recurring characters the viewer must recognise across scenes
avoid_for: topics with no people in them
signals: the same person or creature returns in several beats
